plotSections.title: Vecna, the sister's skin, and a phylactery hint
bullets: Walker says Vecna tried to pass his dead sister's skin off as rat skin. Sylan asks whether her soul might still be in it. Dana says that tracks for him.

Dana asks whether a deal was made with the god of the undead, and whether he hinted at what the phylactery is. Walker remembers him tapping a golden eagle on the table and, at the time, taking it for boredom.

plotSections.title: The helm as a hidden phylactery
bullets: Dana argues the helm is the only piece of his armor still remaining, and that she had a vision of an ordinary item that would go under the nose. She thinks they may have been carrying the phylactery because Walker treated it as a hat. Walker says he grabbed that piece, that the helm is extraordinary rather than mundane, and that it sits over his nose.

Sylan wants the helm examined and moves closer. Walker asks if he is being threatened. Sylan says no. Dana says no one has actually looked at it and they only need to rule it out. Walker agrees to a check.

Dana says identifying it would take Detect Magic and arcane investigation. Sylan says Carlkin offered to identify the helmet if they brought it, and Carlkin was worried that Walker had been carrying it. Walker doubts the helm is the phylactery but will let it be checked.

Dana asks how else he has contacted them from wherever he is. She says it has happened twice, and that Walker has had the helmet the whole time but not the eagle. She notes a phylactery is usually imagined in a treasury, not worn. Sylan asks whether the helm benefits Walker and presses to check it.

plotSections.title: Glimmen tests Walker
bullets: Dana switches to Draconic and asks Glimmen whether Walker has changed in any odd way since wearing the helmet everywhere, wanting a sanity check through their bond. Walker says that if Grixto were influencing either of them, it would be Glimmen.

Glimmen starts to answer, then snaps her head down, clamps her mouth around Walker's head, tells him in his mind to give up the helmet, and lifts him by it. The bite hurts her. Walker refuses to give the party the helmet. He will hand it only to Carlkin.

Glimmen rests her head on him and asks whether phylacteries are flame resistant. Walker says not necessarily. She says she could torch the helmet. She also says he seems influenced, that she is unfit to judge mind control, and that his internal fire can spread and protect her through their bond.

In Draconic to Dana, Glimmen says Walker has not acted any stranger than normal, then still suggests lighting him on fire to see if it burns. Dana asks if he is fire retardant. Glimmen says he will be fine. Walker says he is fire resistant and does not think he is fireproof yet. Glimmen says that sounds like he needs more training. Ciri takes a tinderbox and starts lighting it under Walker's arm.

plotSections.title: Do not destroy it until he is in sight
bullets: Sylan says that if the helm is the phylactery they should not destroy it immediately. They should find him first, because if he senses it destroyed he will make another one. Walker agrees they should destroy it only when they have eyes on him. Sylan says they can still rule the helm out.

Sylan offers a same-day appointment with Carlkin if Walker will not take the helm off in front of the party. Gerk says they do not want to walk in there because he is in a bad way right now. Sylan thinks Gerk should not make the visit and is unsure he should go either. Dana says both of them should stay home.

chronologicalEvents: 1. Walker identifies the skin passed off as rat skin as Vecna's dead sister's skin. Sylan asks if her soul is still in it. Dana asks whether a deal was made with the god of the undead and whether he hinted at the phylactery.
2. Walker recalls the god of the undead tapping a golden eagle on the table, which Walker mistook for boredom.

3. Dana ties her vision of an ordinary item under the nose to the helm, the only remaining piece of that armor. Walker says the helm is extraordinary, sits over his nose, and is not a likely phylactery, but he will allow a check.

4. The party agrees it can be tested with Detect Magic, arcane investigation, or Carlkin. Dana notes Carlkin was already worried Walker had kept it, and that contact happened twice while Walker had the helm but not the eagle.
5. Dana asks Glimmen in Draconic for a sanity check on the helm. Glimmen bites down on it, mind-tells Walker to give it up, and lifts him by it. Walker will surrender it only to Carlkin.

6. Glimmen proposes burning the helm, says Walker seems influenced, and says his bonded fire can protect her. She then tells Dana he has not acted stranger than usual, while still wanting a fire test. Walker calls himself fire resistant, not fireproof. Ciri starts a tinderbox under his arm.
7. Sylan and Walker agree not to destroy a confirmed phylactery until they have eyes on him, or he will make another. They still want the helm ruled out.
8. A Carlkin appointment is proposed for today. Gerk says he is in a bad way. Sylan wants Gerk left out and may stay back himself. Dana tells Gerk and Sylan both to stay home.

Valkyrie.existing: Vecna's sister, killed so her blood and skin could make the Raskina.
notes: Walker says her skin was passed off as rat skin.
Sylan asks whether her soul might still be in the skin. No answer is given in this stretch.
openQuestions: Is her soul still in the skin?

Raskina.existing: Vecna's red-skinned tome, made from his sister and held by Grixto.
notes: The skin in question is treated as Vecna's dead sister's skin, previously passed off as rat skin.
Sylan raises the possibility that her soul is still in it.
openQuestions: Is the sister's soul still in the skin?

notes: Dana asks whether a deal has been made with the god of the undead. The question is not answered here.
Walker says Vecna gave a possible phylactery hint by tapping a golden eagle on the table. Walker thought he was bored.
Dana says he has contacted them twice.
openQuestions: Did the party make a deal with the god of the undead?

Helm.existing: A helm Carlkin agreed to examine by appointment.
notes: Dana calls it the only piece of his armor still remaining. Walker says that is because he grabbed it.
Dana's vision described an ordinary item that would go under the nose. Walker says this helm is extraordinary and sits over his nose, so he does not think it is mundane or the phylactery.
No one in the party has fully examined it. Dana proposes Detect Magic and arcane investigation. Sylan says Carlkin can identify it and was concerned that Walker had carried it the whole time.
Dana's case for it being the contact object is that Walker has had the helmet the whole time and has not had the eagle the whole time.
Walker will not give it to the party. He will hand it to Carlkin. Glimmen tries to take it in her mouth and asks whether a phylactery would be flame resistant.
Sylan returns it to Walker during the argument and offers a same-day Carlkin appointment if Walker will not remove it in front of everyone.
quotesThemes: Walker: he will let Carlkin examine it, but he will hand it to Carlkin.

Phylactery.existing: A vessel containing a lich's soul.
notes: Dana says the usual image is an object kept in a treasury, not something worn.
Walker remembers a golden eagle being tapped on the table as the hint he missed. Dana instead suspects the helm, because it is the object Walker has carried continuously.

Sylan says not to destroy it immediately if confirmed. Find him first. If he senses the destruction, he will make another before they can stop him. Walker agrees they need eyes on him. Ruling the helm out can still happen before that.
Glimmen asks whether phylacteries are flame resistant. Walker says not necessarily. No test result is given.
Walker says the god of the undead was tapping a golden eagle on the table. Walker thought it was boredom and now treats it as a missed hint about the phylactery.
Dana points out Walker has not had the eagle the whole time, unlike the helm.

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric, most knowledgeable of the group.
notes: She presses the question of a deal with the god of the undead and of a phylactery hint.
She had a vision of an ordinary item that would go under the nose and now wants the helm ruled out.
She says a check would take Detect Magic and arcane investigation.
She speaks Draconic to Glimmen and asks for a sanity check on whether the helm has influenced Walker.
She tells Gerk and Sylan both to stay home from the Carlkin visit.
personality: Cautious about the helm and unwilling to treat a worn object as beneath suspicion.
quotesThemes: Wouldn't it be convenient if they had been carrying the phylactery the whole time because Walker thought it was a cool hat?

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter, bonded to Glimmen.
notes: He is wearing the helm and refuses to give it to the party. He will hand it only to Carlkin.
He considers the helm extraordinary, not mundane, and an unlikely phylactery.
He says that if Grixto is influencing either of them, it would be Glimmen.
He is fire resistant and does not believe he is fireproof yet.
Glimmen says his internal fire can spread and protect her through their bond.
Glimmen briefly lifts him by the helm. Ciri starts a tinderbox under his arm. The result is not shown.
personality: Possessive of the helm and skeptical that it is controlling him.
quotesThemes: I ain't giving up my helmet. I'll let Carlkin examine it, but I will hand it to Carlkin.

notes: He asks whether the sister's soul is still in the skin.

He insists the helm be examined, moves closer to Walker, and says he is not threatening him. If Walker will not allow an examination, Sylan says they will have to assume it is hindering him. He then gives the helm back.
He argues against destroying a confirmed phylactery before they find him, because another could be made.
He proposes a Carlkin appointment today, then says Gerk should not go and that he himself probably should not go either.
While brooding, the wind behind him carries dark leaves. It is abnormally cold for the time of year.
personality: Pushy about checking the helm, then careful about destroying a phylactery too early.
quotesThemes: If he senses that the phylactery is destroyed, he will just make another one.

notes: Dana asks her in Draconic whether Walker has seemed odd since wearing the helm everywhere.
She clamps her mouth around Walker's helmeted head, tells him mentally to give up the helmet, and lifts him by it. The grip hurts her.
She asks if phylacteries are flame resistant and offers to torch the helmet.
She says Walker seems influenced, that she cannot diagnose mind control, and that his internal fire can spread and protect her because they are bonded.
She then tells Dana he has not acted any stranger than normal, while still wanting to light him on fire. She says he will be fine and that he needs more fire training.
Ord is unsure Hold Monster would apply to her. Sylan says that is not the concern. Gerk jokes that she could be held by the hand or hugged.
personality: Blunt with Walker, willing to burn the helm to test it, and protective through the bond.
quotesThemes: Do you think phylacteries are flame resistant?
He hasn't acted any stranger than normal.
I think I should still light him on fire and see if it burns.

Grixto.existing: Mobile antagonist hiding his phylactery among mundane possessions.
notes: Walker names Grixto as the one who would be influencing them, and says Glimmen would be the more likely target between the two of them.

Carlkin.existing: Turtle-like person believed to be back in Langdale.
notes: Sylan says Carlkin offered to identify the helmet if they brought it, and that Carlkin was concerned Walker had been carrying it.
The party discusses seeing him the same day. Walker will hand the helm to Carlkin rather than to the party.
Gerk says they do not want to walk in there because he is in a bad way right now. Sylan thinks Gerk should skip the visit and may skip it himself. Dana says both should stay home.
openQuestions: Why is Carlkin in a bad way, and why should Gerk and Sylan stay away?

notes: She takes a tinderbox and starts lighting it under Walker's arm after the fire-resistance talk. No result is shown.
He says they should not walk in on Carlkin because he is in a bad way.
Sylan says Gerk should not make the visit. Dana agrees Gerk should stay home. Gerk asks why and does not get an answer in this stretch.
openQuestions: Why should Gerk stay away from the Carlkin visit?

notes: He offers to Detect Magic.
Sylan asks how close he is to Glimmen. Ord is not sure Glimmen is a creature he can hold with Hold Monster. Sylan says that is not what he is worried about.
When Sylan says Gerk should not make the Carlkin visit, Ord says he is not available.

Golden fire.existing: The life force of Walker's gold dragon rider bond.
notes: Glimmen says Walker's internal fire can spread and protect her because of their bond. She treats him as fire resistant and says further training would make the protection more certain. Walker does not think he is fireproof yet.
